items.item_text: Compliance Certification Board (CCB) certifications: Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC) or Certified in Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC)
Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Public Policy, Law, Health Care or a related field and/or equivalent education/training/experience

Experience performing investigations or audits, including investigating allegations of employee misconduct or policy violations, and interviewing complainants, witnesses and individuals accused of misconduct, as applicable
Experience working within a hospital/health system or an academic institution
Experience preparing detailed investigative reports with clear analysis of facts and findings

The Senior Compliance Investigator is responsible for overseeing, implementing, and performing all Privacy and Compliance investigations charged by the Chief Compliance and/or Privacy Officers in fulfillment of UCDH obligations under University policy to fully and fairly review allegations of improper activities. This position will manage highly complex investigations impacting UCDH that involve multiple regulatory components related to privacy breaches, fraud and abuse, drug diversion, improper business activities, billing irregularities, and health care compliance. In addition, the incumbent will assist other UCDH and campus authorities in completing investigations and providing training and consultative support to other campus investigators. Assignments are of substantial complexity, often focusing on issues that involve multiple policy areas.
Knowledge of federal and state privacy regulations
Demonstrated project management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a highly regulated environment
